title: Wh integer scaling
supported_scope: Linked/inline/single-distinct ReadingType exponent, raw Wh divided by 1000; no other units claimed

existing_tests.title: uses the multiplier linked from the IntervalBlock entry (−3 → /1000 again)
ignores multipliers declared on summary measurements (Oakville-shaped feed)

title: UsagePoint href grouping
supported_scope: self before up before related; path-shaped links only; no URI graph claimed

existing_tests.title: groups readings under the same UsagePoint regardless of link/entry position

title: Namespace-prefix/entry-order tolerance
supported_scope: Prefix removal and reordering accepted; namespace URI collision protection NOT claimed

existing_tests.title: yields identical readings with and without espi: prefixes
does not depend on the order entries appear in the feed
reads CAD and the money scale the schema defines (÷100,000)
reads ElectricPowerUsageSummary under its schema name too

title: Line item/measurement subset
supported_scope: note, rawAmount, itemKind, unitCost, measurement value/multiplier/uom; not rounding/dateTime/itemPeriod

existing_tests.title: keeps every line item with its note verbatim and its raw itemKind

title: LocalTimeParameters single clock
supported_scope: tzOffset/dstOffset/hex rules; one feed-wide clock, not per-UsagePoint linked clocks

existing_tests.title: flips the offset exactly at the transitions
gives the 23-hour and 25-hour days the calendar has
parses tzOffset alone and never invents a DST regime

title: Incomplete billing comparison guard
supported_scope: Existing inferred cadence/coverage guard, NOT explicit ESPI duration coverage

existing_tests.title: refuses to compare a half-covered period (missing data is not a rate miss)

title: Authorization-code OAuth
supported_scope: State/cookie binding, minimal configured scope, code exchange; PKCE optional

existing_tests.title: sends the narrow scope and the registered redirect_uri to the custodian
rejects a callback whose state does not match the cookie

title: Refresh rotation/rejection
supported_scope: Persist rotated refresh; invalid_grant or fresh-token rejection clears locally; no remote revoke claimed

existing_tests.title: persists the rotated refresh token before returning
survives rotation plus a one-shot resource 401 (retry uses the rotated refresh token)
clears the stored tokens and reports grant_revoked when the utility says no

title: Authorization resource pointer
supported_scope: resourceURI extraction and URI-base resolution ONLY; other Authorization XML fields ignored

existing_tests.title: resolves the relative resourceURI the Authorization resource advertises and pipes the feed

title: CMD bounded notification / 202
supported_scope: Notification change-marker only; 202 reports data_pending; no BatchList item semantics/polling claimed

existing_tests.title: accepts a BatchList at the registered token path and only records a timestamp
surfaces an async 202 batch as data_pending instead of hanging

title: XML diagnostics
supported_scope: Malformed/empty/HTML/entity/missing-readings diagnostic only; no unsupported resource/commodity diagnostic

existing_tests.title: names external entities instead of repeating the parser error
explains a feed with entries but no readings
